title: DiffusionART: Efficient, Stable and Scalable Reinforcement of Diffusion Models
title_zh: DiffusionART：高效、稳定且可扩展的扩散模型强化学习

paragraphs.en: Online reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tunes diffusion models with black-box rewards, but reverse-process methods such as Flow-GRPO are limited in efficiency by poor credit assignment, while forward-process methods such as DiffusionNFT are efficient yet unstable without carefully tuned exponential-moving-average (EMA) off-policy training. We show that NFT-style objectives contain a hidden forward–reverse consistency force that joint positive–negative training cancels only partially, and that EMA stabilizes training through restoration rather than off-policy rollouts. We introduce DiffusionART ( Diffusion Reinforcement with A ggregation-First R eward T ilting), which aggregates each prompt’s rewards into a shared reward-improving direction for reverse-process states, removing the consistency force by construction, and adds a trust-region-masked second update for drift-adaptive restoration without EMA tuning. It requires no differentiable reward model, remains effective with fewer samples per prompt, and supports pairwise reward models (DiffusionART-Pairwise). Across image and video generation, DiffusionART trains efficiently and stably without per-task tuning. In particular, on HunyuanVideo-13B with equally weighted visual and motion quality rewards, DiffusionART reaches the late-stage mean reward levels of DiffusionNFT and Flow-GRPO-Fast with 12.02 × 12.02\times and 11.72 × 11.72\times fewer GPU hours, respectively, while achieving 28.8% and 53.0% higher mean training rewards.
paragraphs.zh: 在线强化学习（RL）通过黑盒奖励对扩散模型进行微调，但反向过程方法（如 Flow-GRPO）因信用分配不佳而效率受限；而正向过程方法（如 DiffusionNFT）虽然高效，却因缺乏精心调优的指数移动平均（EMA）离策略训练而不稳定。 我们证明，NFT 风格的优化目标包含一种隐藏的正向–反向一致性力，联合正负样本训练仅能部分抵消该力；而 EMA 通过恢复机制而非离策略 rollout 来稳定训练过程。 我们提出 DiffusionART（扩散强化学习：先聚合后倾斜奖励），该方法将每个提示的奖励聚合为反向过程状态共享的奖励提升方向，从而在结构上消除一致性力，并增加一个信任区域掩码的第二步更新，以实现无需 EMA 调优的漂移自适应恢复。 该方法无需可微分奖励模型，在每提示样本数量较少的情况下仍保持有效，并支持成对奖励模型（DiffusionART-Pairwise）。 在图像和视频生成任务中，DiffusionART 无需按任务单独调优，即可高效且稳定地训练。 具体而言，在 HunyuanVideo-13B 模型上，当视觉质量和运动质量奖励采用等权重时，DiffusionART 所需的 GPU 小时数分别比 DiffusionNFT 和 Flow-GRPO-Fast 少 12.02 × 12.02\times 和 11.72 × 11.72\times，同时其平均训练奖励分别高出 28.8% 和 53.0%。

Our paper targets rectified-flow with linear data–noise interpolation [ Lipman et al., 2022 ] , which shares the core principles of diffusion. are typically trained to fit the data distribution by regressing noise or velocity targets rather than to optimize downstream criteria such as visual quality, motion quality, or human preference, making reward-guided fine-tuning central to recent image and video generation tasks [ Xu et al., 2026a , Gao et al., 2025 ] . paragraphs.en: Within this paradigm, reverse-process RL [ Black et al., 2023 ] , such as Flow-GRPO and its variants [ Liu et al., 2025a , Xue et al., 2025 , He et al., 2025 , Wang et al., 2026 ] , optimizes sampled denoising transitions via group-based endpoint reward feedback. It trains on states actually visited by the generator but requires ODE-to-SDE conversion for tractable likelihoods, and its policy gradient updates each selected transition along its own transition-level sampling noise, weighted by a trajectory-level advantage that this transition only partly determines, resulting in poor credit assignment and limiting training efficiency. Forward-process RL , such as DiffusionNFT [ Zheng et al., 2025 ] , instead applies forward noising to the generated clean samples and regresses velocities with reward-weighted positive and negative objectives. It needs no transition likelihoods and is highly efficient, but it is unstable without two stabilizers: joint positive–negative training and an exponential moving average (EMA) rollout policy whose lag must be tuned for each task [ Zheng et al., 2025 ] . Neither family is thus both efficient and stable without per-task tuning. In this paper, we focus on studying the instability of forward-process RL and developing a scalable algorithm which is both stable and efficient.
paragraphs.zh: 在此框架下，反向过程强化学习 [ Black et al., 2023 ]（例如 Flow-GRPO 及其变体 [ Liu et al., 2025a , Xue et al., 2025 , He et al., 2025 , Wang et al., 2026 ]）通过基于群体的终点奖励反馈来优化采样得到的去噪转换。 该方法在生成器实际访问过的状态上进行训练，但需要 ODE-to-SDE 转换以获得可处理的似然值；其策略梯度更新会沿着每个所选转换自身的转换级采样噪声进行优化，而该噪声的权重由轨迹级的优势决定——这一优势仅部分由当前转换确定，导致信用分配效果不佳并限制了训练效率。 正向过程强化学习（例如 DiffusionNFT [ Zheng et al., 2025 ]）则对生成的干净样本施加正向加噪，并通过奖励加权的正负目标来回归速度。 该方法无需转换似然值且效率很高，但在缺乏两种稳定机制时表现不稳定：联合正负训练，以及一个指数移动平均（EMA）展开策略——其延迟必须针对每个任务进行调优 [ Zheng et al., 2025 ]。 因此，这两类方法在没有针对具体任务的调优时，都无法同时兼具高效性和稳定性。 在本文中，我们专注于研究正向过程强化学习的稳定性问题，并开发一种既稳定又高效的可扩展算法。

paragraphs.en: We first examine NFT-style training, starting from a puzzle: its positive and negative branches share the same ideal reward-improving direction, so either alone should suffice, yet each alone collapses (Figure 2 (a)). We find that NFT’s targets, built from forward-noised endpoints, implicitly assume that the model’s sampling velocity equals the ideal forward velocity induced by its own endpoints. The two differ in practice, and the gap introduces a hidden non-reward-improving forward–reverse consistency force : the positive branch pulls each state’s velocity toward the ideal forward velocity and the negative branch pushes it away. Joint training can cancel this force but only partially, since reward centering balances rewards across samples rather than at each state. The residual can destabilize training and slow the reward optimization. We further show that EMA stabilizes NFT through the restoration force of its lagged reference, not through off-policy rollouts, but the EMA trick must be tuned per task.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先研究 NFT 风格的训练方法，从一个谜题入手：其正向和负向分支共享相同的理想奖励提升方向，因此单独使用任一分支都应该足够，但单独使用时两者都会失效（图 2 (a)）。 我们发现，NFT 的目标由前向噪声化的端点构建而成，这隐式地假设了模型的采样速度等于其自身端点所引发的理想前向速度。 实际上二者存在差异，这种差异引入了一种隐藏的、不利于奖励提升的前向–反向一致性力：正向分支将每个状态的速度拉向理想前向速度，而负向分支则将其推离该速度。 联合训练可以抵消这种力，但只能部分抵消，因为奖励中心化是在样本间平衡奖励，而非在每个状态上平衡。 残余效应可能会破坏训练的稳定性，并减缓奖励优化过程。 我们进一步证明，EMA 是通过其延迟参考的恢复力来稳定 NFT 的，而非通过策略外展开；但 EMA 方法需要根据具体任务进行调整。

paragraphs.en: Driven by these insights, we introduce DiffusionART ( Diffusion Reinforcement with A ggregation-First R eward T ilting). It borrows supervised velocity regression from forward-process training but applies updates to states and actions during reverse-process rollouts. It first aggregates each prompt’s samples and rewards into a shared reward-improving direction G ⁡ ( c ) G(c) , then regresses each visited state’s action toward its guided target (Section 4.1 ). As this target never involves the forward velocity, the consistency force is removed by construction rather than by cross-sample cancellation, and each state receives an explicit reward-improving direction instead of a scalar advantage passed through likelihood ratios. A second update with a trust-region mask mechanism on each rollout adds a restoration force proportional to each state’s drift, replacing EMA with no schedule to tune (Section 4.2 ). paragraphs.en: DiffusionNFT is highly efficient, but its stability relies on joint positive–negative training and an off-policy EMA rollout policy [ Zheng et al., 2025 ] . We examine why both are needed and where they fall short: joint training only partially cancels a hidden forward–reverse consistency force, while EMA provides restoration whose strength requires task-specific tuning. These limitations motivate the two components of DiffusionART in Section 4 .

paragraphs.en: We test these explanations with two ablations. First, retaining EMA-policy rollouts but removing the old-policy anchor from the gradient (i.e. replacing v old v_{\mathrm{old}} by v θ v_{\theta} in v tgt v_{\mathrm{tgt}} of Eq 1 ) still causes collapse (Figure 3 (b)): off-policy data alone does not stabilize NFT. Second, without EMA, we split each rollout batch into two disjoint minibatches and update once on each, using the original objective with β = 1 \beta=1 . The first update starts at v θ ( 0 ) = v old v_{\theta}^{(0)}=v_{\mathrm{old}} , where restoration is zero. paragraphs.en: Why EMA is not enough. EMA controls restoration indirectly through the reference policy’s lag: too little restoration risks collapse, while too much slows reward improvement. Its schedule therefore requires task-specific tuning. DiffusionNFT’s results illustrate this sensitivity [ Zheng et al., 2025 ] : fully on-policy updates collapse, nearly offline updates converge impractically slowly, and the default schedule η = min ⁡ ( 0.001 ​ i , 0.5 ) \eta=\min(0.001i,0.5) , where i i is the iteration, is unstable on OCR, which requires a maximum retention of 0.999 0.999 . In our FLUX experiments, transferring NFT’s GenEval-tuned EMA and β \beta settings also leads to unstable training and can cause collapse (Figure 6 (a)). Such tuning requirement limits scalability.

paragraphs.en: DiffusionART (Algorithm 1 ) combines the advantages of forward- and reverse-process RL, while avoiding their limitations. It applies aggregation-first reward guidance to reverse-rollout states (section 4.1 ) and uses a second MSE update for drift-adaptive restoration (section 4.2 ), addressing the two failure modes identified in Section 3. A trust-region mechanism for an ODE solver further avoids excessive policy updates (section 4.3 ).

paragraphs.en: Unlike math or code, visual outputs often lack objectively verifiable correctness criteria, making pairwise preferences a natural alternative to scalar scores for reward modeling [ Kirstain et al., 2023 ] . DiffusionART-Pairwise is a variant of DiffusionART which naturally supports online pairwise preference feedback [ Kirstain et al., 2023 ] . For each prompt, we divide K K endpoints into K / 2 K/2 disjoint pairs and assign winner/loser labels ( 1 , 0 ) (1,0) , or ( 1 / 2 , 1 / 2 ) (1/2,1/2) for ties. These labels replace scalar rewards in the otherwise unchanged covariance and training pipeline. Appendix C.3 provides the covariance formulation and pseudocode.
paragraphs.zh: 与数学或代码不同，视觉输出通常缺乏可客观验证的正确性标准，因此成对偏好成为标量评分在奖励建模中的自然替代方案 [ Kirstain et al., 2023 ]。 DiffusionART-Pairwise 是 DiffusionART 的一个变体，能够自然地支持在线成对偏好反馈 [ Kirstain et al., 2023 ]。 对于每个提示，我们将 K 个端点划分为 K/2 个互不重叠的成对，并分配胜者/败者标签 (1,0)，或在平局时分配 (1/2,1/2)。 这些标签取代了原本未改变的协方差和训练流程中的标量奖励。 附录 C.3 提供了协方差的公式和伪代码。

paragraphs.en: Single- and multi-reward optimization. We evaluate SD3.5-M [ Stability AI, 2024 ] on GenEval [ Ghosh et al., 2023 ] , OCR, and PickScore [ Kirstain et al., 2023 ] , and further jointly optimize GenEval, PickScore, CLIPScore [ Hessel et al., 2021 ] , and HPSv2.1 [ Wu et al., 2023 ] . Figure 5 (a–d) shows that DiffusionART behaves similarly under single- and multi-reward training. Figure 5 (d) plots the total reward, with components in Appendix A.4 . paragraphs.en: Pairwise feedback and ablation of group size. The performance of DiffusionART with pairwise train reward is close to that obtained with scalar feedback, using scalar reward as the ground truth evaluation metric. paragraphs.en: We studied why NFT-style forward-process diffusion post-training can be unstable and found that its objective can introduce an implicit forward–reverse self-consistency force that is not reliably canceled across states, while stronger restoration can improve stability at the cost of slower reward optimization. DiffusionART presents a simple but effective way to systematically cancel the unstable force by aggregating endpoint reward guidance before assigning it to reverse-rollout states, and then using a second update with a trust-region mechanism to provide drift-adaptive restoration for stabilization. Experiments on image and video generation show efficient, stable reward improvement, including with pairwise feedback and small rollout groups. Beyond the algorithm, our work provides insights into forward-process training, offering a clearer understanding of diffusion reinforcement learning and a path toward scalable diffusion post-training for visual generation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了为何 NFT 风格的正向过程扩散后训练可能不稳定，并发现其目标函数可能会引入一种隐性的正向–反向自洽力，这种力在不同状态间无法可靠抵消；而更强的恢复能力虽能提升稳定性，但会牺牲奖励优化的速度。 DiffusionART 提出了一种简单而有效的方法：在将终点奖励引导分配给反向展开状态之前先进行聚合，从而系统性地抵消这种不稳定的力；随后通过第二次更新结合信任区域机制，提供适应漂移的恢复以实现稳定化。 在图像和视频生成上的实验表明，该方法能高效且稳定地提升奖励表现，即便在使用成对反馈和小规模展开组时也是如此。 除了算法本身，我们的工作还为正向过程训练提供了新的见解，有助于更清晰地理解扩散强化学习，并为视觉生成领域的可扩展扩散后训练指明了方向。

paragraphs.en: From shared guidance to statewise correction. Lemma 2 motivates a shared reward-improving direction computed from the K K endpoints already sampled per prompt. This construction avoids state-conditional posterior sampling and excludes the NFT self-consistency term by construction. However, a prompt-level direction need not match the posterior guidance at every state, and different states can respond differently to the same parameter update. Without statewise correction, the resulting deviations can accumulate, providing a explanation for the gradual deterioration with a single update in Figure 6 . The second MSE update complements shared guidance with local feedback: its restoring force grows with each state’s displacement from the rollout prediction. This controls drift without requiring posterior sampling, combining scalable guidance with statewise stabilization.
paragraphs.zh: 从共享引导到状态级修正。 引理 2 提出了一种共享的奖励提升方向，该方向基于每个提示词已采样的 K 个端点计算得出。 这种构建方式避免了状态相关的后验采样，并且从结构上排除了 NFT 自洽项。 然而，提示词级别的引导方向不必在每个状态下都与后验引导一致，不同状态可能对相同的参数更新产生不同的响应。 如果没有状态级修正，由此产生的偏差可能会累积起来，这可以解释图 6 中单次更新后性能逐渐下降的原因。 第二次 MSE 更新通过局部反馈对共享引导进行补充：其恢复力会随着每个状态偏离展开预测的程度而增强。 这种方式无需后验采样即可控制漂移，将可扩展的引导与状态级稳定机制相结合。

paragraphs.en: Guidance assignment. We compare prompt-global and pair-local guidance on GenEval, using 24 images per prompt to form 12 disjoint pairs. Prompt-global guidance aggregates pair covariances before normalization and applies the shared direction to all trajectories. Pair-local guidance normalizes each pair’s covariance separately and applies it only to that pair. At step 400, prompt-global guidance reaches a held-out GenEval score of 0.91 , versus 0.78 for pair-local guidance. It also achieves higher training rewards (Figure C.3 ), showing that the better practice is pooling the pairs of the same prompt together before computing the covariance to reduce the variance.
